entries.clue: Supports – or declines to intervene? (6,2)

to look on without acting while something happens

annotation.walkthrough: The same phrasal verb means both loyalty and passivity, which is why the dash and question mark set them against each other.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain phrasal verb with two opposite-feeling senses: staying loyal to a friend, and idly watching events.

entries.clue: Break away from some predecessors, being revolutionary (6)
